title: Kaggle validation run: L3 tiny-budget train+eval
purpose: End-to-end pipeline validation (clone -> install -> train -> save -> reload -> eval). Not a strength claim: the budget is deliberately tiny.
findings: Pipeline validated end-to-end; model saved, reloaded from disk, played legal moves.
Trained L3 (tiny budget) loses 0-17-0 to greedy-material: the H5 prediction for a barely-trained learner, so it confirms the harness rather than indicting the model.
MEASURED Kaggle CPU labelling rate: depth-3 = 443.75s / 300 positions = 1.48 s/pos (local was ~0.24 s/pos; the earlier 1.6h-for-24k estimate was ~6x optimistic).

Self-play arm: 18/20 games unfinished at max_plies=120; only the weak shaped-reward branch teaches. With a lenient cap, 40/40 games end in insufficient-material draws -> zero reward. Self-play signal needs fixing before scaling (see KAGGLE-PLAN.md).
